task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Reach the open gripper across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table beside the bowl.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table and move it toward the bowl.
Lower the blue cream cheese block down into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and open the gripper.
Open the gripper and readjust above the blue cream cheese in the bowl.
